owner_decision_controls.decision: One fully reviewed five-smoke GPT cycle is sufficient for scoped WIP completion.
Every material ANDON requires GEMBA, Five Whys, Hansei, owner-source countermeasure, canaries, Smoke A/B, and deterministic verification.
Structural failure blocks canonical cold-review spend while all raw outputs still receive GEMBA.
After authorized push and exact-SHA CI the coordinator may mint candidate/producer/review children under the standing campaign, with listed exceptions.
Cold review is five isolated GPT-5.6 calls with no cross-case context and no sixth synthesis call.
One human may review all five; a second is required only for patch-owner/material reversal or unresolved challenge.
The human hash-claims the full assessment cohort before any cold-review disclosure.
Refusal has three typed outcomes and origin is evidence-derived.
External refusal evidence remains external; executable fixtures are minimized and topic-neutral.
Opus evaluation is optional, post-completion, and separately authorized.
Accepted Opus changes to candidate/verdict-bearing state require paired reconvergence.
The exact external evidence root and create-if-absent child layout are binding.
Raw cycles are retained indefinitely by hash; pruning requires owner authorization and permanent residue.
Cross-cycle pattern analysis follows every failure; recurrence gets deep analysis; final green gets terminal Hansei.
Same-root recurrence stops paid execution until the required deterministic or adjudicated NO path closes.
The convergence objective has no arbitrary cycle/call ceiling.
Infrastructure-only repair needs no fake commit but always a fresh candidate/cycle.
Not every semantic defect is a deterministic checker; strongest topic-neutral observability and human review govern.
Detectability NO is scoped/revisitable and raw triggers emit REASSESSMENT_DUE only.
A legitimate NO permits another cycle only after countermeasure, observability, deterministic green, and independent concurrence.
Candidate consumption is claim-history-sensitive and post-claim states are terminal.
CI green is derived fresh for the exact pushed SHA, remote OID, and required check set.
Review retry preserves producer identity; packet lineage/scope controls one-case versus cohort replay.
Final reviewed green freezes evidence and pauses for owner WIP_COMPLETE acceptance without release authority.
Owner feedback is classified as review plumbing or product feedback before it changes the campaign.
